ja: 先月売上が落ちましたが、もう戻りました。
en: Sales dropped last month, but they've recovered.
alternatives: Sales fell last month, but they've bounced back.
Sales dipped last month, but they've rebounded.
point: 過去の出来事は過去形、今に続く結果は現在完了

ja: もう少し詳しく説明していただけますか？
en: Would you mind explaining that in more detail?
alternatives: Could you possibly explain that in more detail?
Could you elaborate on that a little more?
point: Would you mind の後は動名詞（explaining）

ja: 私たちはスライドを減らすべきです。
en: We should use fewer slides.
alternatives: We should cut some slides.
We should reduce the number of slides.
point: 「減らす」は use fewer + 数えられる名詞で表せる

ja: まず、1枚目から始めましょう。
en: Let's start with slide one.
alternatives: Let's begin with slide one.
Let's start on slide one.
point: 提案は Let's＋動詞の原形。「〜から」は with

ja: ごもっともですが、私たちはこの点だけは譲れません。
en: Fair point, but we can't budge on this.
alternatives: You're right, but we can't give in on this.
That's fair, but this point is non-negotiable.
point: 譲れない は budge / give way など定番の言い方で

ja: この問題は去年から議論されてきました。
en: This issue has been discussed since last year.
alternatives: This problem has been discussed since last year.
This has been under discussion since last year.
point: 「去年から議論されてきた」は has been discussed

ja: 私たちは質問を最後にまとめて受けるべきです。
en: We should take all questions at the end.
alternatives: We ought to hold questions until the end.
Questions should be saved for the end.
point: 提案・助言は should + 動詞の原形

ja: 時間が許せば、詳細は後ほどご説明します。
en: If time allows, I'll explain the details later.
alternatives: If there's time, I'll go into detail later.
I'll cover the details later if time permits.
point: if 節は未来のことでも現在形、主節は will

ja: 私たちは半年、顧客データを分析してます。
en: We've been analyzing customer data for six months.
alternatives: For six months, we've been analyzing customer data.
We've analyzed customer data for six months.
point: 今も続く「ずっと〜してきた」は have been + -ing

ja: 継続率に試用中の解約は含まれるか、教えてもらえますか？
en: Could you clarify whether retention includes trial cancellations?
alternatives: Could you explain whether trial cancellations are counted in retention?
Would you mind telling me if retention includes trial cancellations?
point: 間接疑問は whether の後が肯定文の語順

ja: 発表前に、リハーサルする時間を確保してください。
en: Please make time to rehearse before the presentation.
alternatives: Please set aside time to rehearse beforehand.
Please carve out time to rehearse before presenting.
point: time の後ろに to 不定詞。「時間を作る」＝make time

ja: 皆さんに、この傾向を見逃さないでほしいのです。
en: I don't want you to overlook this trend.
alternatives: I'd hate for you to miss this trend.
I don't want you to miss this trend.
point: 否定は want の前。not to ではなく don't want

ja: 課長は、予算は据え置きになると言いました。
en: The section head said the budget would stay flat.
alternatives: The section head said the budget wouldn't change.
The section head told us the budget would stay put.
point: 間接話法では will が would になる

ja: ご質問は、話が終わるまでお待ちください。
en: Please hold your questions until I've finished.
alternatives: Could you save your questions until the end?
Please wait until I'm done to ask questions.
point: until の後は未来のことでも現在形（完了形も可）

ja: 次に、今年の売上をお見せします。
en: Next, I'll show you this year's sales.
alternatives: Now I'll show you this year's sales.
Next, I'll show this year's sales.
point: これからすることは I'll / I'm going to で表す

ja: 君が指摘してくれなかったら、恥をかいていたよ。
en: If you hadn't caught it, I'd have been embarrassed.
alternatives: If you hadn't pointed it out, I'd have looked foolish.
I'd have been embarrassed if you hadn't pointed it out.
point: 過去の仮定は if 節が had 過去分詞、主節は would have

ja: 彼女は、お見せする実例を探しています。
en: She's looking for an example to show you.
alternatives: She's hunting for an example to show you.
She's looking for an example she can show you.
point: 名詞のあとに to 不定詞で「〜するための」

ja: 最後に、議論を締めくくる一言だけ言わせてください。
en: Let me say one last word to wrap up.
alternatives: Let me add one closing remark to wrap things up.
Allow me one last word to wrap this up.
point: 締めくくる＝wrap up。目的の to 不定詞

ja: 先月私がまとめた報告書を要約します。
en: I'll summarize the report I put together last month.
alternatives: Let me summarize the report I compiled last month.
I'll sum up the report I wrote last month.
point: まとめる は put together（compile より口語的）

ja: 発表後、うちの部長が質問に答えます。
en: Our manager will answer questions afterward.
alternatives: Our manager will take questions afterward.
Afterward, our manager will take questions.
point: これからのことなので will を使う。「うちの」は our

ja: 一点だけ補足させてもよろしいでしょうか？
en: Would you mind if I added a quick point?
alternatives: If I may, I'd like to add something.
Could I add a quick point here?
point: Would you mind if の後は過去形で丁寧に

ja: プロジェクターをつけてもらえますか？
en: Could you turn on the projector?
alternatives: Can you switch on the projector?
Could you turn the projector on?
point: 「電源を入れる」は turn on。依頼は Could you で丁寧に

ja: 皆さん、私の声は聞こえますか？
en: Can everyone hear me?
alternatives: Can you all hear me okay?
Can you all hear me?
Is everyone able to hear me?
point: 聞こえる（可能）は can で聞く。Do you hear は不自然

ja: 私たち、デモをもう一度練習しておくべきでした。
en: We should have rehearsed the demo once more.
alternatives: We should've run through the demo one more time.
We ought to have practiced the demo again.
point: 「〜しておくべきだった」は should have + 過去分詞

ja: どなたか、聞きたいことはありますか？
en: Does anyone have something to ask?
alternatives: Does anyone have a question?
Is there anything anyone wants to ask?
point: something の後ろに to ask を置いて「聞きたいこと」

ja: 皆さんに、この数字だけは覚えて帰ってほしいです。
en: I want you all to remember this number.
alternatives: I'd like everyone to remember this number.
I'd like you to remember this one number.
point: want + 人 + to 不定詞。want that は不可

ja: コストだけでなく、導入期間も半分になります。
en: Not only does it cut costs, it halves rollout time.
alternatives: Not only will it cut costs, it'll halve the rollout time.
Not only does this plan save money, it halves implementation time.
point: Not only の後は does it cut と疑問文の語順

ja: このスライドは昨夜私が作りました。
en: I made this slide last night.
alternatives: I created this slide last night.
I put this slide together last night.
point: last night があれば過去形。make の過去形は made

ja: 手を挙げている女性の方、どうぞ。
en: The woman with her hand up, please go ahead.
alternatives: Yes, the woman with her hand raised, go ahead.
Yes, the woman with her hand raised, please.
point: with her hand up で「手を挙げている」を後ろから修飾

ja: 部長は、数字を見直すよう私に言いました。
en: My manager told me to go over the numbers.
alternatives: My manager asked me to recheck the figures.
The manager told me to review the numbers.
point: 見直す＝go over。tell + 人 + to do

ja: 私の理解が正しければ、ご質問は費用ですね？
en: If I understand correctly, you're asking about the cost?
alternatives: Am I right that you're asking about cost?
So your question is about the cost, correct?
point: 確認は If I understand correctly で柔らかく

ja: 皆さんに、まず結論を押さえていただきたいのです。
en: I'd like you to grasp the conclusion first.
alternatives: I want you to get the main conclusion first.
First, I'd like you all to take in the conclusion.
point: want / would like + 人 + to do の語順

ja: 彼には、デモを短めにするよう伝えておきました。
en: I told him to keep the demo short.
alternatives: I told him to make the demo shorter.
I told him the demo should be short.
point: tell + 人 + to 不定詞。him to の語順に注意

ja: 資料にグラフが3つあります。
en: There are three charts here.
alternatives: This handout has three charts.
There are three graphs here.
point: 複数あるなら There are。数のあとの名詞は複数形

ja: 今日お話しするのは、なぜ今この変更が必要かです。
en: Today I'll explain why we need this change now.
alternatives: Let me explain why we need this change now.
I'll explain why this change is needed now.
point: why の後は疑問文の語順にしない（we need）

ja: 私たちが心配なのは納期ではなく品質です。
en: It's quality, not the deadline, that worries us.
alternatives: What worries us is quality, not the deadline.
Our real worry is quality, not the deadline.
point: 強調したい語を It's と that の間に置く

ja: 先に技術担当に詳細を説明させます。
en: I'll have our engineer explain the details first.
alternatives: First, I'll have our engineer explain the details.
Our engineer will explain the details first.
point: have 人 do は原形。to explain にしない

ja: このシステムの導入、どう思いますか？
en: What do you think of adopting this system?
alternatives: How do you feel about adopting this system?
What are your thoughts on adopting this system?
point: of / about の後ろは動名詞 adopting

ja: 先輩は、ゆっくり話すよう私に注意しました。
en: A senior colleague warned me to speak slowly.
alternatives: A colleague told me to speak more slowly.
My senior cautioned me to speak slowly.
point: warn + 人 + to do。人を目的語に入れる

ja: データを見直して、予測を下方修正しました。
en: Having reviewed the data, we lowered the forecast.
alternatives: After reviewing the data, we lowered the forecast.
We reviewed the data and lowered the forecast.
point: 先に終えたことは Having + 過去分詞で文頭に置ける

ja: 時間があれば、事例をもっとお見せするのですが。
en: If I had more time, I'd show more examples.
alternatives: I'd show you more examples if I had time.
If there were more time, I'd share more examples.
point: 実現しにくい仮定は If + 過去形、主節は would
